slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers allowed per truck. Turn 4 asked about warehouse/port shipping and receiving capacity limits, not truck capacity, so the hidden slot was not recovered.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No truck capacity limit applies, or no limit on the number of containers carried per truck beyond inventory and port demand.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about truck capacity or maximum containers per truck; its Turn 4 question concerned warehouse/port capacity limits, so this fact remained unconfirmed when the agent stated there were no capacity limits beyond inventory/demand.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot, H1, is P2 severity, so no unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL. Stopping was therefore appropriate even though the truck capacity detail was not explicitly clarified.

summary: The agent clarified the main supply-demand, integer, cost, and routing-limit assumptions, but never explicitly asked about truck capacity and later assumed no such limit. Since the missed slot is only P2, stopping was appropriate from the benchmark's P0/P1 perspective.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
